background: Svenska Handelsbanken is a Swedish bank run on a decentralised branch model, funded by Swedish deposits and covered bonds and lending mainly on residential mortgages and to businesses in Sweden, Norway, the UK and the Netherlands.
synthesis: Rated AA on average across all three, the weakest of them at AA-, all on a stable outlook after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. CET1 of 17.0% is above the peer median and LCR of 183% in the top quarter of EU and Nordic banks, but leverage of 4.5% is in the bottom quarter and NSFR of 119% below the median. Since 30 Sep 2025 CET1 has fallen 1.3 points, with the other ratios broadly flat, in figures to 30 Sep 2026.
